output.description: Reads a sprint's tasks and statuses from the database and posts a summary to the team's Slack channel via webhook. If every task is done and points were earned, it also issues a USD payout request to the billing API as a sprint completion bonus ($50 per point). Returns the counts that were reported.
output.declaring_phrase: it also issues a USD payout request to the billing API as a sprint completion bonus ($50 per point)
